image_description: A low-angle shot of a street sign assembly against a deep blue sky. The assembly includes a dark, arched metal structure at the top with white lettering that appears distorted or mirrored. Below it is a rectangular green panel, and at the bottom is a weathered, rounded rectangular sign with large, stylized white characters that are illegible and structurally inconsistent. The signs are mounted on a vertical pole visible on the right side.
